lines: You don't need a new life
You need to know what actually drives you.
caption:
Most advice tells you to change everything. Usually you just need to know what you're driven by.

The archetype test sorts you into one of 12 archetypes, from the King to the Explorer. It's free, there's no login, and you see your archetype right away.

What do you think drives you?

Comment ARCHETYPE and I'll send you the test 📩

#archetypes #selfdiscovery #personality
